title: Garden of Five Senses Delhi - Attractions, Timings & Travel Guide
content:
Garden of Five Senses - Delhi,

Garden of Five Senses in Delhi is more than just a park - it’s an experience that brings together nature, art, culture, and leisure. Spread over 20 acres in Said-ul-Ajaib, near Saket, this beautifully designed garden is the perfect place for relaxation, photography, and enjoying Delhi’s vibrant outdoor life.

History:

The Garden of Five Senses was developed by the Delhi Tourism and Transportation Development Corporation (DTTDC) and opened to the public in 2003. The idea behind its creation was to provide Delhi with a unique space where nature and art meet, allowing visitors to stimulate all five senses - sight, sound, touch, taste, and smell.

Attractions at Garden of Five Senses:

  • Thematic Landscapes - From Mughal-style gardens to herbal patches, the park offers diverse experiences.
  • Art Installations & Sculptures - Beautiful stone and metal structures make it a favorite for art lovers and photographers.
  • Amphitheater - An open-air stage where cultural events, plays, and music shows are held.
  • Food & Cafés - Several food joints and cafés around the park make it a great spot to hang out.
  • Romantic Setting - Known as one of Delhi’s most romantic spots, it’s popular among couples.

Visitor Information:

  • Location: Said-ul-Ajaib, Mehrauli-Badarpur Road, Near Saket Metro Station, New Delhi.
  • Timings: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM (summer); 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (winter).
  • Entry Fee: ₹30 (adults), ₹15 (children & senior citizens).
  • Parking: Paid parking available near the entrance.

How to Reach:

  • By Metro: Nearest metro station is Saket Metro Station (Yellow Line), just 2 km away.
  • By Bus: Regular DTC buses connect Saket and Mehrauli to other parts of Delhi.
  • By Car/Taxi: Easily accessible by cab, auto, or private vehicle.

Best Time to Visit: The garden can be visited throughout the year, but October to March is the best time when the weather is pleasant and perfect for outdoor walks. Evenings are especially popular.

Nearby Attractions:

  • Qutub Minar (3 km)
  • Mehrauli Archaeological Park (3 km)
  • Saket Malls (Select Citywalk, DLF Place – 2 km)
  • Hauz Khas Village (5 km)

Travel Tip: Carry a water bottle and wear comfortable shoes, as the garden involves a lot of walking.
excerpt: The Garden of Five Senses in Delhi is a perfect mix of art, culture, and nature. With its themed landscapes, sculptures, events, and peaceful ambiance, it offers a refreshing escape from the city’s chaos.

faqs.question: Why is Garden of Five Senses famous?
faqs.answer: It is famous for its artistic design, natural beauty, sculptures, and cultural events.

faqs.question: Garden of Five Senses suitable for couples?
faqs.answer: Yes, it’s considered one of Delhi’s most romantic hangout spots.

faqs.question: How much time is needed to explore the park?
faqs.answer: Around 2 to 3 hours is enough to explore the garden leisurely.

faqs.question: Which metro station is nearest to Garden of Five Senses?
faqs.answer: Saket Metro Station on the Yellow Line is the closest.

faqs.question: Food and restaurants available inside Garden of Five Senses?
faqs.answer: Yes, there are cafés and food stalls around the park for visitors.
